thread.text:
Today: Squat ran 40kg×8 warm-up then 80kg×5,5,5 - back on the barbell at the old 80kg×5,5,5 pattern, not the prescribed 70kg for 8-10. RDL anchor hit 80kg×7,7,7, up from 6,6,6 on 11-15 and one step from the 8s that unlock 82.5kg. Leg extension improved to 10kg×10,12,12, two of three sets now at the top of the band. Kneeling leg curl moved up to 10kg×9,9,9 from the repeated 8,8,8. Seated calf raise returned at 40kg×10,10,10, under the band for a second straight reading.

Heart rate: 54 minutes, 10:58 to 11:52, averaging 90 with a 56-139 range - the lowest average of this week's five lifting sessions (92-105 avg). The five-minute trace climbs through the 80s and low 100s mid-session, likely the squat/RDL block, then fades to 76 and 84 at the close through the lighter accessory work.

Sleep: 6h13 the night before (03:41-10:05, HRV 151, 41 avg asleep), under the week's 7h15 average; no normal yet with 9 of 14 nights banked. Nothing in today's lifts reads as flat, so there's no clear link to draw.

Trend: RDL's 7,7,7 is the best reading yet at 80kg across three sessions in the band (5,7,5 tired on 10-02, 6,6,6 on 11-15). Kneeling leg curl's 9,9,9 completes its fourth session in that slot, which per plan makes Nordic curls the candidate next. Seated calf raise has sat under the 15-20 band twice running (10-02's 10,10,10 and today's), so 35kg is next time.

Next session: Upper A, Monday. Incline bench stays at 70kg chasing 8s on all three working sets. Pull-ups at +10kg, second slot, chasing 8s across three. Lateral raise 8kg, first two sets 15-20, last set to failure as planned.

Question: Squat went 80kg×5,5,5 again instead of the 70kg/8-10 ask or the pendulum swap, matching the 09-27/10-02 pattern. Was that a deliberate call to keep the barbell at that weight, or should the slot just be logged as the barbell going forward?
squats should be high weight low rep exercises, so instead i went for that instead of prescription

That's a real training philosophy, but it's not what the prescription is built around here. The whole reason squat dropped to 70kg for 8-10 reps was 09-12's note: your knees talked at 80kg×5. The plan's answer was reps, not plates, and today's 80kg×5,5,5 is the exact pattern that triggered that call in the first place, with no mention either way of how the knees felt this time.

I can't change the slot for you. If you want squat run as a low-rep, high-load movement going forward, that's a real preference and it goes to your coach at the next planning session, along with whatever your knees are telling you now at 80kg×5. Worth saying plainly whether they're fine today, because that's the detail the log can't give.
